reuse.why: Calls the shared getScheduledAmount, which already resolves missing, single and ranged amounts (furthest from zero) for the other consumers.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is taken from the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts, where the API's schedule shape is built.

scope.why: One type field, one mapping line and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simple and follows the shared rule; the read-only field lives on the same APIScheduleEntity type used for input, guarded only by a comment.
